answer.evidence: The top band spans rows 9-11 in a mid-light orange (L~126). Row 12 is a lighter front-edge line (#d59147, L~157), and rows 13-14 are dark eave shadow (#744e2c, then #2a180b). styleAnswer.evidence: The confessional is a clean 3-tile wooden facade with a cornice, a lattice door and purple curtains. The dark edge pixels are 0% neutral, so the outline is a tinted dark brown beside the wood, which matches Beodeul. Near-flat coverage is 0%, so there are no large flat fills. Its 10 visible tones per tile are roughly level with the hedge (9) but about half of the comparable stall (17) and roofed well (20). With only 18 distinct colours in total (stall 40, well 38), each material (wood, curtain, trim) gets about 3-4 lightness steps against the 5-6 Beodeul uses. The wood reads mostly as banded planks with little per-plank grain, highlight or speckle, and the curtains are shaded shallowly. It is neat and consistent but a step flatter and thinner than the stall and well references, so it does not clearly reach the bar.
